title: No automatic upload to Tidepool
symptom: Upload to Nightscout happens automatically, but no upload is made to Tidepool even after waiting more than 24 hours. Sometimes tapping on upload now asks for user ID and password, then uploads, but it does not keep uploading.
cause: The thread does not definitively establish a root cause. It is suspected to be a regression in version 3.4.0.0, possibly related to connection options blocking uploads even when restrictions are met, or a change to OAUTH2.
fix: The thread does not state a definitive fix. A workaround that temporarily worked was logging out and back in under the Tidepool menu in AAPS, but it stopped again. The issue was reported to be working fine with version 3.4.2.0.
evidence_quote: This was solved for me by Jim Kelly on facebook. I had to tap on logout under the Tidepool menu in AAPS. Then, tap on login in the same menu and enter the credentials again in the browser that comes up. Since then, 14 hours ago, it has been uploading a new value every 5 minutes with a 3-hour delay non-stop.
